Container.Name: deepseek-v4-flash-vulkan
Container.Overview: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) served by llama.cpp on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) via Vulkan (RADV, performance profile). [br]Weights are the UD-IQ2_XXS 3-shard set with the dspark Q8_0 draft model, using llama.cpp's draft-dspark speculative decoding (3 draft tokens, p-min 0.3); start.sh downloads them on first boot if the models share is empty (aria2, resumable, SHA-256 checked). 131K context, q8_0 K/V cache, no mmap. [br]Runtime config lives in /config/start.sh (seeded from the repo on first boot — edit it there to change model, draft model, context, or draft depth). No container environment variables are used. [br]This is the Vulkan half of the A/B pair: it needs only /dev/dri (no /dev/kfd), and only one of this container or qwen38-flash-next-gufo can hold the GPU at a time. Stop one before starting the other and give the driver a moment to release GTT. [br]The quant is deliberately aggressive (IQ2_XXS) because the model is large; if output quality disappoints, that is the knob to revisit, not the server flags.
Container.PostArgs: -c "if [ ! -s /config/start.sh ]; then curl -fsSL -o /config/start.sh.tmp https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iknox/unraid-templates/main/config-examples/deepseek-v4-flash-vulkan.start.sh && mv /config/start.sh.tmp /config/start.sh || { rm -f /config/start.sh.tmp; echo 'failed to seed /config/start.sh'; exit 1; }; fi; exec bash /config/start.sh"
Container.Description: Strix Halo Vulkan llama-server for DeepSeek V4 Flash UD-IQ2_XXS + dspark. Host port 9931 maps to the server's 8080. Configure via /config/start.sh on the appdata share — no env vars.

Config.Name: HTTP / API
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible llama-server API (WebUI at root). Host 9931 is llama.cpp's announced future default.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: GGUF files. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-UD-IQ2_XXS/ (3 shards + dspark Q8_0) is downloaded here automatically on first boot if absent.

Config.Name: Runtime config
Config.Description: Holds start.sh — the llama-server command line (model, dspark draft model, context, speculative settings). Seeded automatically on first boot; edit and restart to apply.
